description: This file defines a class 'DetailView' within the 'Step\Acceptance' namespace, which extends 'AcceptanceTester'. The class provides methods for interacting with the detail view in acceptance tests, such as clicking action menu items and waiting for the detail view to become visible.

classes.name: DetailView
classes.description: A class providing acceptance testing methods for detail view interactions in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: clickActionMenuItem
methods.description: Clicks on the specified action menu item within the detail view.

methods.name: waitForDetailViewVisible
methods.description: Waits until the detail view element is visible on the page.
